description: Source code for VSyncReactor class managing VSync timing, fences, and period transitions in Android SurfaceFlinger scheduler.

classes.name: VSyncReactor
classes.description: Manages VSync timing, fences, and period transitions for a display.

classes.name: VsyncController
classes.description: Base class with destructor, likely a parent class for VSync management.

methods.name: addPresentFence
methods.description: Adds a fence to the VSyncReactor, updates timestamp tracking, and manages internal state.

methods.name: setIgnorePresentFences
methods.description: Sets external ignore fences flag and updates internal fence handling.

methods.name: setIgnorePresentFencesInternal
methods.description: Sets internal ignore fences flag and updates fence list accordingly.

methods.name: updateIgnorePresentFencesInternal
methods.description: Clears unfired fences if ignoring fences internally or externally.

methods.name: startPeriodTransitionInternal
methods.description: Begins transition to a new VSync period, sets confirmation flags.

methods.name: endPeriodTransition
methods.description: Ends current period transition, resets transition state.

methods.name: startPeriodTransition
methods.description: Initiates a period transition, with optional force parameter.

methods.name: periodConfirmed
methods.description: Checks if the VSync period has been confirmed based on timestamps and tolerances.

methods.name: addHwVsyncTimestamp
methods.description: Adds a hardware VSync timestamp, manages period confirmation, and updates tracker.

methods.name: setDisplayPowerMode
methods.description: Sets the display power mode affecting VSync handling.

methods.name: dump
methods.description: Outputs internal state and metrics for debugging.
